descriptionChirho: A concrete noun denoting the object, matter, or ground of boasting -- that which one boasts about or takes pride in. Greek καύχημα (distinct from καύχησις which denotes the act of boasting) refers to the thing boasted of or the basis for pride. Spanish 'orgullo, motivo de jactancia' (pride, reason for boasting); Hindi घमण्ड/घमन्द (pride, boast); Arabic افْتِخارُ / فَخْرَ (boasting, pride, glory); Korean 자랑 / 자랑이 (boast, something to boast about); Swahili kujisifu (to boast about, self-praise). S70587 (nominative/accusative) and S70589 (genitive) are case inflections of the same sense, appearing in Pauline epistles (1 Cor 5:6, 9:15-16; 2 Cor 1:14, 5:12, 9:3; Gal 6:4; Phil 1:26, 2:16; Heb 3:6) for the subject matter of one's boasting.
